representation.prompts: Native HTML and KaTeX for every prompt with original wording, part labels, marks, bold emphasis, question-specific instructions and faithful vector figure crops. As in the earlier imports, printed captions such as "Figure 1" sit outside the crop; the alt text of each figure names it.
representation.solutions: Every question-specific mark-scheme page as ordered vector crops: working, marks, AOs, alternatives, special cases, examiner notes and diagrams. General marking pages and publisher pages are excluded.

cropMethod: PyMuPDF show_pdf_page clip to SVG with text as paths. Figure boxes snap to the drawing items wholly inside the caption region. Scheme page bounds cover all text spans, vector drawings and embedded images; breaks fall only in empty horizontal bands, preferring table rules and paragraph gaps; invisible white background fills are ignored when finding bands.
sourceNotes: Files were identified by their covers, not their names; the full inventory (SHA-256, page counts, pairing, duplicates) is on GitHub #124.

June 2018 9MA0/03 Statistics and Mechanics is one paper (Section A Statistics Q1-5, Section B Mechanics Q6-10) and keeps its original numbering; each question is mapped to its own content. Q6-10 carry the Section B instruction about g verbatim.
June 2019 9MA0/31 and 9MA0/32 question papers have outlined text (no text layer): wording, part marks and figure bounds were taken from the page images and drawing paths.
June 2019 9MA0/31 Q2: the box plot is cropped inside the page frame so the grey frame bar is excluded.
Blank mark scheme pages are not attached to any question: June 2018 9MA0/02 pages 10, 22 and 32, and June 2018 9MA0/03 page 12.
June 2019 9FM0/01 and 9FM0/02 schemes start several questions mid-page; each cut lies above the question header row, so every question carries only its own scheme.

June 2019 9MA0/01 Q2: Diagram 1 (question paper page 5) is the copy of Figure 1 that candidates draw on; only Figure 1 is reproduced and the wording "Diagram 1, on the opposite page, is a copy of Figure 1" is kept verbatim.
mathsReview: Every question solved independently with SymPy and numeric checks (private scripts) and compared with the official scheme answers; no mathematical discrepancies and no source errors found.
